entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: A great skyship capable of planar travel, designed by Urza as part of the Legacy; compleated in the second Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The planeswalker who designed the Weatherlight and bred Gerrard Capashen for it.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: First captain of the Weatherlight, who later led its reconstruction.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Inherited the ship from her family and was kidnapped and rescued from Rath.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: Descendant of the Capashen Clan bred by Urza, who joined the crew.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Taken hostage by the Predator's crew; part of the Weatherlight may live inside him.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: Crew member taken hostage by the Predator's crew.

entities.name: Shanna Sisay
entities.description: Became captain after Jhoira's retirement and removed the powerstone before the ship's compleation.

entities.name: Teferi Akosa
entities.description: Used the Weatherlight's powerstone to power the Temporal Anchor and was trapped in time.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A compleated planeswalker who struggled with Teferi Akosa.

entities.name: Tiana
entities.description: Restarted the Weatherlight's original powerstone engine.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: Gave the Weatherseed as a present to Dominaria.

entities.name: Lord of the Wastes
entities.description: Mysteriously killed Sisay's family.

entities.name: Predator
entities.description: A rival ship that ambushed and dueled the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Powerstone
entities.description: The Weatherlight's main power source, infused with white mana from Serra's Realm.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion in which the Weatherlight was central to Urza's plans.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The second invasion during which the Weatherlight was compleated.

entities.name: Primeval Crosis
entities.description: Event that destroyed the Weatherlight, which was reborn as a sentient being.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian ruler whose Black Cloud of Death the Weatherlight fought over Urborg.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Where the Weatherlight was destroyed a final time and later raised.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: Plane the Weatherlight planeshifted to after Sisay's kidnapping.

entities.name: Mercadia
entities.description: Plane where the Weatherlight was upgraded and freed the people from Phyrexian oppression.

entities.name: Belzenlok's Cabal
entities.description: Enemy Jhoira's new crew fought.

entities.name: Mending
entities.description: Event after which planar travel technology stopped working.

entities.name: Temporal Anchor
entities.description: A time machine designed by Saheeli Rai and housed in Urza's Tower.

events.summary: The Weatherlight's maiden voyage rescues thousands of refugees from collapsing Serra's Realm with Jhoira as captain.
events.quote: The skyship's maiden voyage was devoted to rescuing thousands of refugees from the collapsing Realm, with Jhoira serving as its first captain.

events.summary: Urza breeds generations of the Capashen Clan, resulting in Gerrard Capashen.
events.quote: He began experiments on the Capashen Clan of Benalia , which eventually resulted in the birth of Gerrard Capashen .

events.summary: Urza entrusts the ship to a Zhalfirin family; Sisay inherits it after the family is killed by the Lord of the Wastes.
events.quote: Sisay inherited the ship from her family after they were mysteriously killed by the Lord of the Wastes .

events.summary: Weatherlight planeshifts to Rath and is ambushed and boarded by the Predator, whose crew take hostages.
events.quote: Predator' s crew took Karn , Tahngarth , and the Legacy artifacts hostage

events.summary: Weatherlight and Predator duel again as Weatherlight races to the portal and escapes.
events.quote: Weatherlight just managed to get to the portal and escape her pursuer, with both vessels sustaining major damage.

events.summary: On Mercadia the ship is upgraded and helps free the people from Phyrexian oppressors.
events.quote: Weatherlight was also instrumental in freeing the peoples of Mercadia from their Phyrexian oppressors.

events.summary: The ship is destroyed by the Primeval Crosis and reborn as a sentient being, then destroyed a final time over Urborg.
events.quote: The ship was destroyed by the Primeval Crosis , only to be reborn as a completely sentient being.

events.summary: Sixty years after the Mending Jhoira raises the wreck, restores it with a new hull seed, and assembles a crew against Belzenlok's Cabal.
events.quote: Jhoira led an expedition off the coast of Urborg to raise the remains of the Weatherlight .

events.summary: Shanna Sisay becomes captain after Jhoira retires.
events.quote: Shanna Sisay became the new captain of the Weatherlight .

events.summary: The Weatherlight is compleated; Shanna removes the powerstone and the ship fights at the Battle of the Mana Rig.
events.quote: Shanna was able to remove the ship's powerstone before it escaped.

events.summary: Teferi Akosa uses the powerstone to power the Temporal Anchor after a struggle with compleated Ajani; the stone implodes and traps Teferi in time.
events.quote: The powerstone later imploded, overloading the anchor and trapping Teferi in time.

relations.quote: The Weatherlight was invented by Urza in the Tolarian Academy
with Jhoira serving as its first captain.
Shanna Sisay became the new captain of the Weatherlight .

relations.note: Assembled a crew to fight them.
relations.quote: Jhoira assembled a new crew to fight Belzenlok 's Cabal .

relations.note: Bred him through experiments on the Capashen Clan.
relations.quote: Urza set out to breed the perfect human for his perfect ship.
